raul-rangel.name: Raúl Rangel
raul-rangel.profile: Raúl Rangel emerged as Chivas' first-choice goalkeeper in 2024-25, impressing with his composure and shot-stopping at a young age. He is a commanding presence in the box and considered one of Liga MX's most promising young keepers.
strengths: Calm under pressure for his age
weaknesses: Limited European-level experience
Distribution under high press still developing

carlos-acevedo.name: Carlos Acevedo
carlos-acevedo.profile: Carlos Acevedo is an experienced Liga MX goalkeeper who has been one of the league's more reliable shot-stoppers. Technically solid and a good communicator with his defence.
strengths: Reliable shot-stopper with consistent Liga MX performances
Strong positioning and reading of the game
weaknesses: Has not proven himself outside Liga MX
Occasionally vulnerable to crosses in the 6-yard box

guillermo-ochoa.name: Guillermo Ochoa
guillermo-ochoa.profile: Guillermo Ochoa is a Mexican football legend who has represented his country at five World Cups, renowned for extraordinary saves on the biggest stages. At 39, he continues playing in Europe as one of the sport's most celebrated international goalkeepers.
strengths: World Cup pedigree spanning five tournaments
weaknesses: Age has reduced his explosiveness and range
Playing at a lower European level limits match sharpness

israel-reyes.name: Israel Reyes
israel-reyes.profile: Israel Reyes is a tall, athletic centre-back who has established himself as one of Liga MX's best young defenders at Club América. His aerial ability and reading of the game make him a key figure in Mexico's defensive setup.
strengths: Dominant in aerial duels for his position
Reads the game well for a young defender
weaknesses: Pace can be exposed by quick forwards in behind
Building passing range to match elite CBs

jesus-gallardo.name: Jesús Gallardo
jesus-gallardo.profile: Jesús Gallardo is a reliable left-back with tremendous experience for Mexico, known for his energy and defensive solidity. A veteran of the national team, he provides stability and overlapping runs from the flank.
strengths: Experienced and dependable left-back for Mexico
Good at pressing high and winning the ball back
Delivers quality crosses from the left
weaknesses: Attack-minded opponents with pace can trouble him
Not a dominant force in one-on-one defending

jorge-sanchez.name: Jorge Sánchez
jorge-sanchez.profile: Jorge Sánchez is an attacking right-back who plays in the Greek Super League, combining defensive solidity with effective overlapping runs. He has established himself in European football and is an important attacking outlet for Mexico.
strengths: Effective overlapping right-back with good delivery
European experience in PAOK's European campaigns
weaknesses: Decision-making in the final third can be inconsistent
Better in attack than defensive recovery runs

cesar-montes.name: César Montes
cesar-montes.profile: César Montes is a commanding centre-back who has had stints in Europe including Espanyol and Monterrey before Lokomotiv Moscow. A physical, ball-playing defender who is a cornerstone of Mexico's defence.
strengths: Commanding aerial presence and physical strength
weaknesses: Playing in the Russian league limits top European exposure
Can be impetuous and pick up needless yellow cards

johan-vasquez.name: Johan Vásquez
johan-vasquez.profile: Johan Vásquez is a technically assured centre-back who has established himself in Serie A with Genoa, bringing a calm reading of the game and good passing range. One of Mexico's most promising central defenders.
strengths: Comfortable on the ball with good passing range
Strong positional sense in a compact back four
Serie A experience has sharpened his technical game
weaknesses: Physicality can be tested against physical strikers
Still developing consistency at the highest level

mateo-chavez.name: Mateo Chávez
mateo-chavez.profile: Mateo Chávez is one of Mexico's most exciting defensive prospects, developing at PSV Eindhoven in one of Europe's most competitive youth environments. A modern full-back with excellent technique and a bright future ahead.
strengths: Outstanding technical quality for a defender
Excellent positional awareness for his age
Top European development environment at PSV
weaknesses: Limited senior international experience
Still physically maturing at 21

erik-lira.name: Erik Lira
erik-lira.profile: Erik Lira is a tough-tackling defensive midfielder who anchors Cruz Azul's midfield with physicality and work rate. A natural ball-winner, he provides protection for the back four and sets the team's tempo.
strengths: Excellent ball-winning ability in defensive midfield
High work rate and energy throughout 90 minutes
Good positioning to break up opposition attacks
weaknesses: Limited creative output going forward
Technical polish under pressure still improving

luis-romo.name: Luis Romo
luis-romo.profile: Luis Romo is a versatile and intelligent midfielder who has been one of Liga MX's most complete central midfielders. Capable of both defensive and creative work, he is a reliable figure in Mexico's midfield.
strengths: Versatile — can play multiple midfield roles
Good range of passing from deep
weaknesses: Not an explosive player in transition
Creative output limited at international level

obed-vargas.name: Obed Vargas
obed-vargas.profile: Obed Vargas is Mexico's most exciting young midfielder, who excelled at Seattle Sounders before completing a move to Atlético Madrid in February 2026. At just 20, he combines pressing intensity, ball retention, and composure far beyond his years.
strengths: Exceptional for his age — elite pressing and passing at MLS level
Joined Atlético Madrid — validates his world-class potential
Technical quality and vision to unlock defences
weaknesses: No senior La Liga minutes yet — joining Atlético is a major step up
Still physically developing against elite competition

brian-gutierrez.name: Brian Gutiérrez
brian-gutierrez.profile: Brian Gutiérrez is a young dynamic midfielder at Chivas who has earned a reputation as one of Liga MX's most exciting emerging talents. Comfortable on the ball, he presses well and contributes in both phases.
strengths: High technical quality for a young midfielder
Good combination play in tight spaces
weaknesses: Consistency at the senior level still developing
Limited European exposure

orbelin-pineda.name: Orbelín Pineda
orbelin-pineda.profile: Orbelín Pineda is a creative attacking midfielder who has built his European career in Greece, known for his dribbling and goal threat from midfield. A versatile threat who can play wide or centrally.
strengths: Creative dribbler who attracts multiple defenders
Goal threat from midfield — scores and creates
European experience in Greece and previous clubs
weaknesses: Playing level in Greece limits European benchmarking
Can be inconsistent in big international matches

edson-alvarez.name: Edson Álvarez
edson-alvarez.profile: Edson Álvarez is Mexico's best midfielder, a powerful and technically accomplished box-to-box player who was one of the Premier League's top defensive midfielders at West Ham. Combative, composed, and a natural leader in the engine room.
strengths: Elite defensive midfielder — outstanding at ball recovery in the PL
Technically gifted — passes quickly and rarely wastes possession
Natural captain figure who commands the midfield
weaknesses: Can be too aggressive and collect yellow cards
Less effective in pure chance creation than box-to-box peers

gilberto-mora.name: Gilberto Mora
gilberto-mora.profile: Gilberto Mora is a hard-working attacking midfielder at Club Tijuana who uses energy and directness to create problems for opponents. A reliable Liga MX performer working to break into the national team set-up.
strengths: Direct and energetic attacking midfield play
weaknesses: Not yet established at the highest international level
Technical ceiling unclear against elite opposition

cesar-huerta.name: César Huerta
cesar-huerta.profile: César Huerta is a pacey and technical winger who made his mark in Belgium at Anderlecht after a breakthrough in Liga MX. An explosive dribbler who can play on either flank and takes players on with confidence.
strengths: Explosive pace and one-on-one dribbling ability
Belgian Pro League experience sharpened his European game
Can play on either flank with effectiveness
weaknesses: Final product — crossing and finishing — can be inconsistent
Still adapting to top-level European football

alvaro-fidalgo.name: Álvaro Fidalgo
alvaro-fidalgo.profile: Álvaro Fidalgo is a Spanish-born attacking midfielder who chose to represent Mexico, bringing La Liga quality to El Tri's midfield. A technically gifted playmaker with excellent vision and passing ability from a Real Betis environment.
strengths: La Liga quality in the midfield — elite technical standard
Excellent vision and passing to unlock defences
Brings European composure and intelligence to Mexico
weaknesses: International adaptation with Mexico still a work in progress
Less effective in defensive midfield duties

luis-chavez.name: Luis Chávez
luis-chavez.profile: Luis Chávez is a dynamic box-to-box midfielder renowned for his explosive long-range shooting, including one of the most celebrated free kicks in recent World Cup history at Qatar 2022. A powerful presence who covers ground effectively.
strengths: Explosive long-range shooting and set-piece delivery
High physical output and box-to-box energy
weaknesses: Playing in the Russian league reduces European exposure
Can be one-dimensional when his shooting is neutralised

roberto-alvarado.name: Roberto Alvarado
roberto-alvarado.profile: Roberto Alvarado is a quick and tricky winger at Chivas who excels in one-on-one situations and contributes goals and assists consistently in Liga MX. A versatile attacker who gives Mexico width and creativity.
strengths: Quick and direct — effective in one-on-one situations
Good at winning fouls and creating set-piece opportunities
weaknesses: Has not yet tested himself in a major European league
Can be neutralised by well-organised defences

alexis-vega.name: Alexis Vega
alexis-vega.profile: Alexis Vega is a versatile attacking player who can function as a winger or second striker, known for his creativity and set-piece quality. A seasoned Liga MX performer who brings experience and flair to Mexico's attack.
strengths: Versatile — effective as a winger or second striker
Creative set-piece delivery and free kicks
Liga MX experience and consistent performances
weaknesses: Fitness has been a concern during his career
European level remains untested

julian-quinones.name: Julián Quiñones
julian-quinones.profile: Julián Quiñones is a prolific striker who finished as one of the Saudi Pro League's top scorers in 2024-25 with 20 goals. A powerful and direct centre-forward with natural goal-scoring instincts.
strengths: 20 goals in the Saudi Pro League — elite goal-scoring form
Physical and direct — difficult to handle in the box
Excellent movement to find space in the penalty area
weaknesses: Saudi Pro League standard differs from top European leagues
Sometimes anonymous in build-up play outside the box

santiago-gimenez.name: Santiago Giménez
santiago-gimenez.profile: Santiago Giménez is Mexico's most lethal striker of this generation, who became one of Europe's most sought-after forwards after a prolific stint at Feyenoord before joining AC Milan. Clinical, intelligent, and physically complete, he is Mexico's focal point up front.
strengths: Elite European striker — prolific at Feyenoord and AC Milan
Technically refined finishing from all angles
Intelligent movement and link-up play for a centre-forward
weaknesses: Settling into San Siro's demands and expectation takes time
Needs consistent service to maintain his goal output

guillermo-martinez.name: Guillermo Martínez
guillermo-martinez.profile: Guillermo Martínez is a consistent goal-scorer in Liga MX at Pumas UNAM, a hard-working striker who leads the line effectively and makes intelligent runs. A reliable contributor in the Mexican league.
strengths: Intelligent movement in the penalty area
Works hard for the team off the ball
weaknesses: Has not been tested in European football
Limited international career opportunities

armando-gonzalez.name: Armando González
armando-gonzalez.profile: Armando González is a young, energetic forward at Chivas whose pace and directness make him a constant threat in Liga MX. Still developing, but his athleticism and raw talent have earned him a place in the 2026 squad.
strengths: Explosive pace and directness in attack
Exciting young talent with Liga MX experience
High work rate and pressing from the front
weaknesses: Decision-making and final ball still maturing
Limited international experience

raul-jimenez.name: Raúl Jiménez
raul-jimenez.profile: Raúl Jiménez is a Mexican icon who defied the odds after a life-threatening skull fracture to return and score 12 Premier League goals for Fulham in 2024-25. A complete striker with technical excellence, aerial ability, and leadership.
strengths: 12 Premier League goals in 2024-25 — elite top-flight output
Complete striker with aerial, technical, and clinical qualities
Inspirational resilience and veteran leadership for Mexico
weaknesses: Age (34) means managing minutes across a long tournament
Has played through significant career injury history

ronwen-williams.name: Ronwen Williams
ronwen-williams.profile: Ronwen Williams is South Africa's undisputed number one goalkeeper, arguably Africa's best keeper, who starred in Bafana Bafana's run to the 2023 AFCON semi-finals with a remarkable penalty shootout save sequence. A commanding keeper with extraordinary reflexes.
strengths: Elite reflexes — hero of 2023 AFCON penalty shootouts
Dominant in his area and authoritative with his defence
Consistent top-level performer at Mamelodi Sundowns
weaknesses: Playing standard in PSL differs from European top divisions
Distribution could be more varied at times

ricardo-goss.name: Ricardo Goss
ricardo-goss.profile: Ricardo Goss is a capable backup goalkeeper for South Africa, providing reliable cover behind Ronwen Williams. A steady presence between the sticks who has grown through the South African football system.
strengths: Reliable backup option with PSL experience
Good positioning and command of the box
weaknesses: Limited opportunities at the highest international level
Below the standard of the first-choice keeper

sipho-chaine.name: Sipho Chaine
sipho-chaine.profile: Sipho Chaine is the third-choice goalkeeper for South Africa and the deputy at Orlando Pirates, a young keeper developing alongside one of South Africa's biggest clubs. Athletic and agile with a promising future.
strengths: Athletic and agile with sharp reactions
Good age profile and development arc at Pirates
Learning from competing in CAF competitions
weaknesses: Third choice means limited national team experience
Still establishing himself at club level

khuliso-mudau.name: Khuliso Mudau
khuliso-mudau.profile: Khuliso Mudau is an energetic right-back at Mamelodi Sundowns who combines strong defensive qualities with attacking contributions. A key member of the Sundowns treble-winning setup and a dynamic full-back for Bafana.
strengths: Strong defensively with good positioning at right-back
PSL and CAF Champions League experience
weaknesses: Yet to test himself in European football
Can be exposed by wingers with high pace

olwethu-makhanya.name: Olwethu Makhanya
olwethu-makhanya.profile: Olwethu Makhanya has become a reliable MLS performer at Philadelphia Union, bringing South African defensive solidity to American soccer and gaining valuable experience in a competitive league environment.
strengths: MLS experience brings a higher standard than PSL
weaknesses: MLS not a European top-five league benchmark
Not a major attacking contributor from defence

bradley-cross.name: Bradley Cross
bradley-cross.profile: Bradley Cross is a left-back at Kaizer Chiefs who brings experience from one of South Africa's biggest clubs. A composed defender who operates effectively in PSL football.
strengths: Solid left-back with experience at a major PSL club
weaknesses: Limited experience outside South Africa
Attacking contribution from left-back is minimal

thabang-matuludi.name: Thabang Matuludi
thabang-matuludi.profile: Thabang Matuludi is a dependable centre-back at Polokwane City who earned his international call-up through consistent performances in the PSL. A physically strong defender who reads the game well.
strengths: Physically strong and dominant in aerial duels
weaknesses: Playing for a smaller PSL club limits visibility
Limited international experience

nkosinathi-sibisi.name: Nkosinathi Sibisi
nkosinathi-sibisi.profile: Nkosinathi Sibisi is Orlando Pirates' first-choice centre-back, a commanding defender who combines physicality with good ball-playing ability. A regular for Bafana Bafana and a key figure in the CAF arena.
strengths: Commanding aerial defender and physical presence
weaknesses: PSL standard differs from European top divisions
Can be drawn out of position when pressed high

aubrey-modiba.name: Aubrey Modiba
aubrey-modiba.profile: Aubrey Modiba is an attacking left-back at Mamelodi Sundowns who regularly contributes going forward. A Sundowns regular who has been part of their dominant PSL campaigns.
strengths: Effective overlapping left-back with good delivery
Sundowns experience means high standard of tactical discipline
Contributes assists and key passes from deep
weaknesses: Not tested at European level
Defensive duties can be tested against top pace wingers

khulumani-ndamane.name: Khulumani Ndamane
khulumani-ndamane.profile: Khulumani Ndamane is a young and versatile defender at Mamelodi Sundowns who can cover multiple positions across the backline. Developing rapidly in one of Africa's best club environments.
strengths: Strong development at Africa's top club
weaknesses: Still establishing a fixed international role
Limited senior international minutes

ime-okon.name: Ime Okon
ime-okon.profile: Ime Okon is a German-born South African centre-back playing in the 2. Bundesliga at Hannover 96. His European background gives Bafana Bafana a defender comfortable with pressing-based systems.
strengths: European experience in the German second tier
weaknesses: International experience for South Africa still limited
2. Bundesliga is not top-flight football

samukele-kabini.name: Samukele Kabini
samukele-kabini.profile: Samukele Kabini plays in the Norwegian Eliteserien at Molde, providing South Africa with a European-based defender. A disciplined full-back who has adapted well to Scandinavian football.
strengths: Disciplined and reliable in defensive duties
weaknesses: Norwegian league level differs from top European competition
Not a major creative contributor

mbekezeli-mbokazi.name: Mbekezeli Mbokazi
mbekezeli-mbokazi.profile: Mbekezeli Mbokazi is a young South African defender making his mark in MLS at Chicago Fire. A technically composed defender developing through American soccer's competitive environment.
strengths: MLS experience at a young age
Technically sound and composed on the ball
weaknesses: Limited senior international experience
MLS not at the level of European top flights

teboho-mokoena.name: Teboho Mokoena
teboho-mokoena.profile: Teboho Mokoena is South Africa's most complete midfielder, a dynamic box-to-box player who combines defensive work with creative output. His performances at Sundowns and for Bafana have drawn comparison to some of Africa's best midfielders.
strengths: Complete midfielder — defends, passes, and scores effectively
Physical and technical quality stand out at African level
Leaders on the pitch — organisational and driving force
weaknesses: Has attracted interest but not yet moved to a major European league
Standard against top European midfielders remains untested

jayden-adams.name: Jayden Adams
jayden-adams.profile: Jayden Adams is one of South Africa's most exciting young midfielders, a technically gifted player who has thrived at Mamelodi Sundowns. His energy and passing quality make him a key figure in the next generation of Bafana.
strengths: Outstanding technical quality for a young midfielder
Good press resistance and composure on the ball
High energy and work rate in midfield
weaknesses: Still developing physically against senior-level opponents
International experience building at 22

thalente-mbatha.name: Thalente Mbatha
thalente-mbatha.profile: Thalente Mbatha is a reliable central midfielder at Orlando Pirates who combines physicality with good passing. A consistent performer in the PSL who brings stability to South Africa's midfield.
strengths: Physically strong and combative in midfield
Experienced PSL performer at a major club
weaknesses: Creative output is limited
Has not been tested in European football

kamogelo-sebelebele.name: Kamogelo Sebelebele
kamogelo-sebelebele.profile: Kamogelo Sebelebele is a young and energetic midfielder at Orlando Pirates who has impressed with his pressing intensity and ability to win the ball. An emerging talent in the South African set-up.
strengths: High pressing intensity and energy in midfield
Good ball recovery and work rate
weaknesses: Still young — consistency at senior level developing
Technical ceiling not fully established

sphephelo-sithole.name: Sphephelo Sithole
sphephelo-sithole.profile: Sphephelo Sithole is a South African midfielder who plays in Portugal, giving Bafana Bafana a European-based option. His time in the Portuguese Segundaliga has helped him develop technically.
strengths: Technical development from a European environment
weaknesses: Segunda Liga level is below the top European standard
Not yet established as a regular Bafana starter

oswin-appollis.name: Oswin Appollis
oswin-appollis.profile: Oswin Appollis was named PSL Footballer of the Season 2024-25 for his stunning performances at Orlando Pirates, contributing 11 goals and 9 assists. A direct and explosive winger with exceptional technical skill and end product.
strengths: PSL Footballer of the Season 2024-25 — 11 goals and 9 assists
Explosive pace and directness in one-on-one situations
Strong combination of goal threat and creativity from wide areas
weaknesses: Yet to be tested at a major European club
High-pressure World Cup stage is a new experience

tshepang-moremi.name: Tshepang Moremi
tshepang-moremi.profile: Tshepang Moremi is a young forward at Orlando Pirates who provides pace and direct running in behind defences. An exciting prospect at 22 who earned his World Cup place through consistent development.
strengths: Explosive pace to run in behind defences
Young and developing rapidly at Pirates
weaknesses: Finishing consistency is still maturing
Not yet established as a reliable international scorer

evidence-makgopa.name: Evidence Makgopa
evidence-makgopa.profile: Evidence Makgopa is a physical centre-forward at Orlando Pirates who has been a consistent goal scorer in the PSL. A powerful striker whose physicality makes him a handful for defenders.
strengths: Physical and powerful centre-forward difficult to handle
Consistent PSL goal scorer at a major club
Strong hold-up play and aerial ability
weaknesses: Has not proven himself outside South African football
Needs good service to be effective

lyle-foster.name: Lyle Foster
lyle-foster.profile: Lyle Foster is South Africa's leading striker in European football, developing at Burnley after a standout year in the Premier League. A powerful and mobile centre-forward who gives Bafana Bafana a target the opposition must respect.
strengths: Physical power and aerial ability in the box
weaknesses: Burnley's relegation from PL limited top-level exposure in 2024-25
Goal output in Championship still developing

iqraam-rayners.name: Iqraam Rayners
iqraam-rayners.profile: Iqraam Rayners was the PSL's top contributor in 2024-25 with a remarkable 24 goals and 10 assists in 46 matches for Mamelodi Sundowns. A prolific forward who is the heartbeat of the Sundowns attack and South Africa's most in-form striker.
strengths: 24 goals and 10 assists in 2024-25 — PSL's most prolific player
Intelligent movement and clinical finishing in the box
High fitness levels — played 46 games across the season
weaknesses: Has not tested himself at a major European club
PSL level means the World Cup will be a significant jump

relebohile-mofokeng.name: Relebohile Mofokeng
relebohile-mofokeng.profile: Relebohile Mofokeng is South Africa's most exciting young player — a teenage sensation at Orlando Pirates who has been drawing comparisons to the great SA players of past generations. Electric pace, skill, and maturity far beyond his years.
strengths: Exceptional maturity at 20 — composed in big moments
Pirates fans regard him as the most exciting talent in a generation
weaknesses: Young — World Cup pressure is a new challenge
Physical development still ongoing at 20

themba-zwane.name: Themba Zwane
themba-zwane.profile: Themba Zwane is South Africa's most decorated domestic player, a veteran of many Sundowns title victories whose creativity and technical quality remain high. A player of incredible experience who provides leadership in the attack.
strengths: Vast PSL and CAF experience — one of South Africa's all-time greats
Creative and technically brilliant in tight spaces
Provides veteran leadership alongside younger attackers
weaknesses: Age (34) means limited minutes and intensity possible
Playing in the PSL throughout his career limits European exposure

thapelo-maseko.name: Thapelo Maseko
thapelo-maseko.profile: Thapelo Maseko is an experienced South African winger who plays in Cyprus, bringing European exposure to Bafana Bafana's squad. A direct winger with good pace and delivery.
strengths: Direct and pacy winger with good delivery
weaknesses: Cypriot league standard is not among Europe's top divisions
International impact has been inconsistent

song-bum-keun.name: Song Bum-keun
song-bum-keun.profile: Song Bum-keun is the backup goalkeeper for South Korea, a reliable K-League performer at Jeonbuk who has proven himself as a consistent domestic goalkeeper. A capable deputy to the number one.
strengths: Reliable K-League performer with a solid record
weaknesses: Not the first choice and rarely tested at international level
K-League standard differs from European goalkeepers

jo-hyeon-woo.name: Jo Hyeon-woo
jo-hyeon-woo.profile: Jo Hyeon-woo is South Korea's first-choice goalkeeper, a commanding keeper at Ulsan HD who has been a stalwart of the national team. Known for heroic performances in pressure situations and a dependable presence between the sticks.
strengths: South Korea's most experienced and reliable goalkeeper
Commanding in his penalty area with good reading of play
Proven international performer in big matches
weaknesses: Age (33) means managing match sharpness across a tournament
K-League level means limited exposure to elite striking partnerships

kim-seung-gyu.name: Kim Seung-gyu
kim-seung-gyu.profile: Kim Seung-gyu is a veteran goalkeeper now playing in the J-League at FC Tokyo, providing South Korea with an experienced third option. A former first-choice with vast international experience.
strengths: Vast international experience from previous World Cups
Leadership and experience to support younger keepers
weaknesses: Age (34) and third-choice status mean limited competition impact
J-League exposure at this stage of career

jens-castrop.name: Jens Castrop
jens-castrop.profile: Jens Castrop is a German-Korean full-back developing in the Bundesliga at Borussia Mönchengladbach, choosing to represent South Korea internationally. His Bundesliga experience makes him one of the most technically advanced Korean defenders.
strengths: Bundesliga experience provides elite defensive education
Modern full-back with good technical qualities
weaknesses: International integration with Korea still developing
Not yet a regular starter at Mönchengladbach

lee-han-beom.name: Lee Han-beom
lee-han-beom.profile: Lee Han-beom is a left-back at Midtjylland in Denmark who has established himself in European football. A composed and disciplined defender with good technical qualities and European exposure.
strengths: Danish Superliga experience at an ambitious club
Technically sound left-back with good positioning
European exposure and Champions League qualifying experience
weaknesses: Danish league level below top-five European leagues
Yet to perform on the biggest international stage

park-jin-seob.name: Park Jin-seob
park-jin-seob.profile: Park Jin-seob is a centre-back in the Chinese Super League at Zhejiang FC who provides South Korea with additional cover at the back. A physically strong defender developing his game.
strengths: Physical and imposing in aerial duels
Consistent in the Chinese Super League
weaknesses: Chinese Super League is below European standard
Limited exposure to top European strikers

lee-ki-hyuk.name: Lee Ki-hyuk
lee-ki-hyuk.profile: Lee Ki-hyuk is a domestic centre-back at Gangwon FC in the K-League who provides depth for South Korea's defence. A technically solid defender in the Korean league.
strengths: Reliable K-League defender with consistent performances
Good positioning and reading of the game
weaknesses: K-League level limits comparison to European defenders
Not a regular international starter

kim-min-jae.name: Kim Min-jae
kim-min-jae.profile: Kim Min-jae is one of the world's best centre-backs, a dominant defensive presence at Bayern Munich who combines extraordinary physical attributes with elite technical ability. His powerful defending, aerial dominance, and calmness with the ball make him a true world-class talent.
strengths: World-class centre-back — regularly rated among Europe's best
Physically dominant in aerial and ground duels
Excellent ball-playing ability for a defender — links attack from deep
weaknesses: Concentration lapses have occasionally cost Bayern in big matches
Recovery from his rare off nights is key in tournaments

kim-moon-hwan.name: Kim Moon-hwan
kim-moon-hwan.profile: Kim Moon-hwan is a right-back at Daejeon Hana Citizen who has been a consistent K-League performer. An attacking full-back known for his energy and willingness to get forward.
strengths: Energetic right-back with good forward runs
weaknesses: Domestic league limits benchmarking against European right-backs
Not a regular first-choice for Korea

kim-tae-hyon.name: Kim Tae-hyon
kim-tae-hyon.profile: Kim Tae-hyon is a South Korean defender in the J-League at Kashima Antlers. A technically sound full-back developing his career in Japan's competitive environment.
strengths: J-League experience with one of Japan's top clubs
Technical quality from the Korean football system
weaknesses: Not yet breaking into the senior Korea starting eleven
J-League level an intermediate step in his development

lee-tae-seok.name: Lee Tae-seok
lee-tae-seok.profile: Lee Tae-seok is a South Korean centre-back at Austria Wien in the Austrian Bundesliga, gaining European experience at a young age. A technically composed defender with good positioning.
strengths: European experience in the Austrian Bundesliga
Young age profile with room to grow
weaknesses: Austrian league level below top European competitions
Still building international experience

seol-young-woo.name: Seol Young-woo
seol-young-woo.profile: Seol Young-woo is a South Korean full-back at Red Star Belgrade who participates in UEFA Champions League qualifying, gaining European experience at a prominent Balkan club.
strengths: Champions League qualifying experience at Red Star
Good technical qualities from Korean football
Developing rapidly in a European environment
weaknesses: Still establishing himself internationally
Serbian SuperLiga below top-five European leagues

cho-yu-min.name: Cho Yu-min
cho-yu-min.profile: Cho Yu-min is a left-back at Sharjah FC in the UAE Pro League who brings South Korea an option at full-back. A technically capable defender playing in the Middle East.
strengths: Left-back option with UAE Pro League experience
Good technical base from Korean football
weaknesses: UAE Pro League standard is below European competition
Not a regular starter in the national team

lee-dong-gyeong.name: Lee Dong-gyeong
lee-dong-gyeong.profile: Lee Dong-gyeong is a dynamic attacking midfielder at Ulsan HD who contributes goals and creativity in the K-League. A technically gifted player who has been a consistent performer for the national team.
strengths: Creative and goal-scoring threat from midfield
Consistent K-League performer at a top club
weaknesses: Has not yet moved to European football
K-League experience the limit of his competitive standard

hwang-hee-chan.name: Hwang Hee-chan
hwang-hee-chan.profile: Hwang Hee-chan is a pacey and hardworking forward-midfielder at Wolverhampton who has become a consistent Premier League performer. Direct and energetic, he is South Korea's most reliable European-based attacker alongside Lee Kang-in.
strengths: Premier League quality — proven top-flight performer
Explosive pace and direct running to destabilise defences
Good goal threat from wide areas and in transition
weaknesses: Finishing can be inconsistent when played through the middle
Wolves' defensive shape means limited creative responsibility

yang-hyun-jun.name: Yang Hyun-jun
yang-hyun-jun.profile: Yang Hyun-jun is an exciting winger at Celtic who has impressed in the Scottish Premiership with his pace and directness. He combines a good end product with technical quality, having emerged as one of Korea's most promising young attackers.
strengths: Pace and directness make him a constant threat
Strong Celtic season with goals and assists
Good technical quality and confidence on the ball
weaknesses: Scottish Premiership standard below major European leagues
Still developing consistency on the big international stage

hwang-in-beom.name: Hwang In-beom
hwang-in-beom.profile: Hwang In-beom is a technically gifted central midfielder at Feyenoord in the Eredivisie, a composed passer with good defensive awareness. He has been one of Korea's most complete midfielders in recent years.
strengths: Eredivisie quality — technically polished in a demanding environment
Good pass range and ball retention
weaknesses: Can be peripheral in the biggest Champions League matches
Not the most explosive physical midfielder

lee-jae-sung.name: Lee Jae-sung
lee-jae-sung.profile: Lee Jae-sung had a career-best season in 2024-25 at Mainz 05, scoring 7 goals and contributing 6 assists in 33 Bundesliga appearances including a brace against Bayern Munich. A versatile and technically refined midfielder who is a crucial figure for Korea.
strengths: 7 goals and 6 assists in 33 Bundesliga apps — career-best season
Scored against Bayern Munich — big-game performer
Versatile — can play multiple positions across the midfield
weaknesses: Age (31) means managing intensity across a long tournament
Not the most explosive player physically

kim-jin-gyu.name: Kim Jin-gyu
kim-jin-gyu.profile: Kim Jin-gyu is a midfield workhorse at Jeonbuk who provides energy and ball-winning qualities. A reliable domestic performer who has worked his way into the national team picture.
strengths: High work rate and energy in midfield
weaknesses: Limited European exposure
Not a major creative contributor

eom-ji-sung.name: Eom Ji-sung
eom-ji-sung.profile: Eom Ji-sung is a young South Korean midfielder developing in the Championship at Swansea City. A technically capable player building his European experience in the English second division.
strengths: Good technical quality from Korean football
Young and developing with strong potential
weaknesses: Championship level not yet top-flight
Still building senior international experience

bae-jun-ho.name: Bae Jun-ho
bae-jun-ho.profile: Bae Jun-ho is a young attacking midfielder at Stoke City who has shown great promise in the Championship. One of the brightest Korean prospects of his generation, known for his technical quality and ability to beat men.
strengths: Exciting young talent with Championship experience
Good technical ability — can beat players in tight spaces
High potential with many years of development ahead
weaknesses: Championship level still a step below top-flight
Limited senior international caps at 22

lee-kang-in.name: Lee Kang-in
lee-kang-in.profile: Lee Kang-in is South Korea's most technically gifted player, a creative attacking midfielder at PSG with extraordinary vision, dribbling, and passing. He is the playmaker around whom Korea's attacking game is built, with the technical quality to unlock any defence.
strengths: PSG quality — creative midfielder at one of Europe's elite clubs
Extraordinary technical skill — dribbling, passing, and vision
Goal and assist threat from midfield — provides spark in big matches
weaknesses: Playing time at PSG has at times been inconsistent given competition
Needs to be in form to unlock his full impact at the World Cup

paik-seung-ho.name: Paik Seung-ho
paik-seung-ho.profile: Paik Seung-ho is a South Korean midfielder at Birmingham City in the Championship, a composed and technical player developing in English football. Known for his passing range and calm presence in midfield.
strengths: Good passing range and composure on the ball
weaknesses: Championship level is below Premier League standard
Not yet established as a regular international starter

cho-gue-sung.name: Cho Gue-sung
cho-gue-sung.profile: Cho Gue-sung is a powerful centre-forward at Midtjylland who became a star at the 2022 World Cup with two headed goals against Ghana. He missed the entire 2024-25 season through injury but returns for the 2026 tournament as a key attacking option.
strengths: World Cup hero — two goals vs Ghana in 2022, proven big-game performer
Dominant in aerial duels — exceptional header of the ball
Physical target striker who holds up play effectively
weaknesses: Missed entire 2024-25 season through injury — match fitness is a question
Form and sharpness heading into the tournament uncertain

son-heung-min.name: Son Heung-min
son-heung-min.profile: Son Heung-min is the greatest South Korean footballer of his generation and one of the most beloved players in world football. A former Tottenham Hotspur captain with 159 Premier League goals to his name, he now leads LAFC in MLS and captains Korea into his third World Cup as the team's talisman.
strengths: 159 Premier League goals — one of the greatest ever in the English top flight
Two-footed and capable of scoring from any position or angle
Inspirational captain and leader who elevates teammates around him
weaknesses: Age (34) means managing intensity and minutes across a tournament
MLS football is below his previous Premier League standard

oh-hyeon-gyu.name: Oh Hyeon-gyu
oh-hyeon-gyu.profile: Oh Hyeon-gyu is a young striker at Besiktas in Turkey who offers South Korea pace and directness in attack. A developing centre-forward with good movement and a sharp eye for goal.
strengths: Young striker with European Turkish league experience
Good movement and pace to exploit space in behind
weaknesses: Turkish league level below top five European leagues
Still maturing as a finisher in European football

lukas-hornicek.name: Lukáš Horníček
lukas-hornicek.profile: Lukáš Horníček is the backup goalkeeper for the Czech Republic, developing at Braga in the Portuguese top flight. A young, technically capable keeper gaining valuable European experience.
strengths: Portuguese Primeira Liga experience at a major club
Young goalkeeper with a strong development arc
weaknesses: Behind Kovář in the national team hierarchy
Still building senior-level experience

matej-kovar.name: Matěj Kovář
matej-kovar.profile: Matěj Kovář is Czech Republic's first-choice goalkeeper and one of the most promising young keepers in Europe, excelling at PSV Eindhoven in the Eredivisie and UEFA Champions League. A commanding, technically excellent goalkeeper with extraordinary composure for his age.
strengths: Outstanding young keeper — Champions League performer at PSV
Exceptional composure and distribution for a 23-year-old
Eredivisie and UCL experience makes him ready for a World Cup
weaknesses: Limited senior international experience at the top level
Managing expectations as Czech Republic's young number one

jindrich-stanek.name: Jindřich Štaněk
jindrich-stanek.profile: Jindřich Štaněk is a commanding goalkeeper at Slavia Prague who has been one of Czech football's best domestic keepers. A reliable shot-stopper with European conference league experience.
strengths: Dominant in the air and commanding with his defence
Czech Liga and European conference experience
weaknesses: Behind Kovář in national team pecking order
Czech Liga level below elite European goalkeepers

vladimir-coufal.name: Vladimír Coufal
vladimir-coufal.profile: Vladimír Coufal had an outstanding 2024-25 Bundesliga season at Hoffenheim, starting all 34 league matches and registering 8 assists — one of the best full-back seasons in the German top flight. A tenacious, attacking right-back with vast Premier League and international experience.
strengths: Started all 34 Bundesliga matches with 8 assists — elite right-back output
Former Premier League performer with West Ham — proven top-level quality
High intensity, non-stop running — impossible to tire over 90 minutes
weaknesses: Age (32) means managing minutes over a long tournament
Occasionally caught out of position when attacking

david-doudera.name: David Douděra
david-doudera.profile: David Douděra is an energetic attacking right-back at Slavia Prague who is a regular contributor in the Czech Liga and European competitions. Known for his tireless running and overlapping ability on the right flank.
strengths: Energetic overlapping right-back with good delivery
Consistent Czech Liga performer with European experience
High work rate and pressing from the back
weaknesses: Czech Liga level means comparison to top European right-backs is limited
Defensive positioning can be exposed by quick wingers

tomas-holes.name: Tomáš Holeš
tomas-holes.profile: Tomáš Holeš is a versatile defender at Slavia Prague who can play at centre-back or as a defensive midfielder. His tactical flexibility makes him a valuable asset for the Czech national team.
strengths: Tactical versatility — effective as CB or DM
Consistent Czech Liga performer at the double-winning Slavia
Good reading of the game and positioning
weaknesses: Has not tested himself in a major European league
Not an outstanding attacker from defensive positions

robin-hranac.name: Robin Hranáč
robin-hranac.profile: Robin Hranáč is one of Czech Republic's most promising centre-backs, playing in the Bundesliga at Hoffenheim. Physically imposing with excellent ball-playing ability, he is developing into a top European defender.
strengths: Bundesliga quality — established as a regular in Germany
Physically dominant with good passing range
Young — best years still ahead of him
weaknesses: Still establishing himself among Europe's very best CBs
Can be tentative in certain defensive transitions

stepan-chaloupek.name: Štěpán Chaloupek
stepan-chaloupek.profile: Štěpán Chaloupek is a young centre-back developing at Slavia Prague, one of Czech football's most successful clubs. A technically composed defender who is building his experience at European level.
strengths: Developing well in a top Czech Liga environment
Technically composed and calm on the ball
weaknesses: Limited senior international experience
One of the squad's less-tested defenders at the top level

david-jurasek.name: David Jurásek
david-jurasek.profile: David Jurásek is a left-back at Slavia Prague who has been one of the Czech Liga's more dynamic full-backs. A technically good defender with an eye for forward passes.
strengths: Dynamic left-back with good forward runs
weaknesses: Yet to make a move to a major European league
Consistency at the senior level still improving

ladislav-krejci.name: Ladislav Krejčí
ladislav-krejci.profile: Ladislav Krejčí is a young centre-back establishing himself in the Premier League at Wolverhampton, bringing top-flight English football experience to Czech Republic's defence. A technically composed defender with an impressive upward trajectory.
strengths: Premier League regular — top-level English football experience
Strong technical quality and composure on the ball
Young — enormous potential with many years ahead
weaknesses: Still building consistent top-flight experience
Physical duels against elite strikers a growing edge

jaroslav-zeleny.name: Jaroslav Zelený
jaroslav-zeleny.profile: Jaroslav Zelený is a dependable centre-back at Sparta Prague who has been a consistent figure in the Czech Liga. A composed and physical defender contributing in Sparta's European campaigns.
strengths: Consistent Czech Liga performer at a top-two club
Physical and disciplined in defensive duels
weaknesses: Czech Liga level limits comparison to top European defenders
Not yet tested at the highest international level

david-zima.name: David Zima
david-zima.profile: David Zima is a solid centre-back at Slavia Prague who previously had stints in Serie A. A physically strong defender who has been a reliable figure in Slavia's back line.
strengths: Serie A experience at Torino provides top-level Italian football background
Physically imposing and commanding in aerial duels
weaknesses: Returned to Czech Liga after Serie A stint
Not yet established as a first-choice international CB

lukas-cerv.name: Lukáš Červ
lukas-cerv.profile: Lukáš Červ is a box-to-box midfielder at Viktoria Plzeň who combines physical work rate with technical quality. A consistent performer in the Czech Liga with experience in European qualifying.
strengths: Box-to-box energy and physical work rate
Czech Liga consistency with European experience
weaknesses: Not yet tested in a major European league
Limited international experience

vladimir-darida.name: Vladimír Darida
vladimir-darida.profile: Vladimír Darida is a Czech football veteran who has had an outstanding career in the Bundesliga with Hertha Berlin. At 34, he now plays domestically at Hradec Králové but brings an extraordinary wealth of experience and leadership to the squad.
strengths: Bundesliga veteran — one of Czech football's most experienced midfielders
Versatile — capable of multiple midfield roles
weaknesses: Age (34) significantly limits physical output
Hradec Králové level is below where he needs to compete

lukas-provod.name: Lukáš Provod
lukas-provod.profile: Lukáš Provod is a creative attacking midfielder at Slavia Prague who has been one of the Czech Liga's most influential players. A technically gifted playmaker who creates chances and scores goals consistently.
strengths: Creative playmaker — one of Czech Liga's most influential midfielders
Goal and assist threat from attacking midfield
weaknesses: Has not yet moved to a major European league
International impact can be inconsistent

michal-sadilek.name: Michal Sadílek
michal-sadilek.profile: Michal Sadílek is a disciplined and technically capable central midfielder at Slavia Prague. Previously developed in the Netherlands at Twente, he brings good positional awareness and composure to the Czech midfield.
strengths: Netherlands-developed — technically refined in Eredivisie culture
Good positioning and composure in midfield
Reliable and disciplined — rarely wastes possession
weaknesses: Not a high-profile creative or goal-scoring midfielder
Still establishing himself as a regular international

hugo-sochurek.name: Hugo Sochůrek
hugo-sochurek.profile: Hugo Sochůrek is one of Czech football's brightest young midfield prospects at Sparta Prague. An energetic and technical player who has developed rapidly in Sparta's domestic and European campaigns.
strengths: Outstanding young prospect at the Czech Liga's best club
High energy and technical quality in midfield
Champions League qualifying exposure at a young age
weaknesses: Still very young — consistency at senior level being established
International stage is a new challenge at 22

alexandr-sojka.name: Alexandr Sojka
alexandr-sojka.profile: Alexandr Sojka is a midfielder at Viktoria Plzeň who provides the Czech Republic with solid depth in the engine room. A hard-working player with good tactical discipline.
weaknesses: Not a standout creative or goal-scoring midfielder
Czech Liga level the limit of his current exposure

tomas-soucek.name: Tomáš Souček
tomas-soucek.profile: Tomáš Souček is Czech Republic's most impactful midfielder, a 6'4" box-to-box powerhouse at West Ham who scored 9 Premier League goals in 2024-25. His aerial dominance, energy, and goal-scoring from midfield make him one of the best of his type in English football.
strengths: 9 Premier League goals in 2024-25 — elite output for a central midfielder
Aerial dominance — extraordinary header of the ball
Physical engine who covers every blade of grass across 90 minutes
weaknesses: Not a refined technical playmaker — best as an enforcer
Can be isolated if Czech Republic sit deep and reduce his runs

pavel-sulc.name: Pavel Šulc
pavel-sulc.profile: Pavel Šulc had a breakout 2024-25 season at Lyon in Ligue 1, scoring 11 goals from an attacking midfield role to establish himself as one of Europe's most exciting emerging players. A technical and creative player with excellent movement into the box.
strengths: 11 Ligue 1 goals in 2024-25 — breakout European season
Excellent movement from midfield to arrive late and score
Technical quality and creativity from an advanced position
weaknesses: Still proving himself consistently at the top European level
Needs to replicate this club form at international level

denis-visinsky.name: Denis Višinský
denis-visinsky.profile: Denis Višinský is a young and energetic midfielder at Viktoria Plzeň who has been building a reputation in the Czech Liga as a dynamic presence in central areas. He is developing rapidly with regular European qualifying exposure.
strengths: High pressing and work rate in central areas
Regular European qualifying exposure at Plzeň
weaknesses: Still establishing himself at the top level
Not yet a dominant creative or defensive force

adam-hlozek.name: Adam Hložek
adam-hlozek.profile: Adam Hložek joined Hoffenheim from Bayer Leverkusen in 2024 and delivered a strong Bundesliga season with 8 goals and 3 assists in 27 matches, finally getting the regular minutes he was denied at Leverkusen. A technically gifted forward with excellent movement and versatility.
strengths: 8 Bundesliga goals in 2024-25 — excellent output for a 22-year-old forward
Bundesliga experience at two clubs gives strong European pedigree
Technical quality and versatility across attacking positions
weaknesses: Still inconsistent in the final ball in wide areas
Has yet to replicate club form consistently at international level

tomas-chory.name: Tomáš Chorý
tomas-chory.profile: Tomáš Chorý is a powerful target striker who has been one of the Czech Liga's top scorers for several seasons at Slavia Prague. A physically imposing centre-forward who uses his frame to hold up play and finish powerfully.
strengths: Dominant aerial presence — exceptional target striker in the Czech Liga
Powerful finishing from close range with 18 league goals
Strong hold-up play and ability to bring teammates into play
weaknesses: Not an explosive pace-based striker — can be isolated without good service
Has not yet proven himself outside Czech football

mojmir-chytil.name: Mojmír Chytil
mojmir-chytil.profile: Mojmír Chytil is a mobile striker at Slavia Prague who previously had a spell in the Eredivisie with Utrecht, and has been developing into one of Czech football's top young forwards. Mobile, technically sharp, and strong at combining with teammates.
strengths: Mobile striker who links play intelligently
Strong development arc — improving each season
weaknesses: Still inconsistent in front of goal at the highest level
Less physically dominant than traditional Czech target strikers

jan-kuchta.name: Jan Kuchta
jan-kuchta.profile: Jan Kuchta is a prolific striker at Sparta Prague who has been one of the Czech Liga's most consistent goal scorers. A direct, hard-working forward with excellent movement in the box and an eye for goal in big matches.
strengths: Consistent Czech Liga goal scorer at a top-two club
Clever movement and goal-poaching instincts in the box
weaknesses: Has not yet made a sustained move to a stronger European league
Can struggle when isolated from service in international football

patrik-schick.name: Patrik Schick
patrik-schick.profile: Patrik Schick is the Czech Republic's greatest striker of his generation, scoring 21 Bundesliga goals in 2024-25 (27 across all competitions) to finish as Leverkusen's top scorer and second only to Harry Kane in the German top flight. A complete centre-forward with exceptional movement, clinical finishing, and the ability to deliver in the biggest moments.
strengths: 21 Bundesliga goals in 2024-25 — one of Europe's elite strikers
Scored hat-tricks against Heidenheim and Leipzig — elite big-game output
Complete striker — aerial, technical, and clinical from all angles
weaknesses: Injury history has interrupted his career at times
Must manage workload carefully to stay fit across a full tournament

dayne-st-clair.name: Dayne St. Clair
dayne-st-clair.profile: Canada's undisputed number one goalkeeper, St. Clair was the 2025 MLS Goalkeeper of the Year with Minnesota United before joining Inter Miami ahead of 2026. His shot-stopping ability and composure under pressure make him one of the most reliable keepers in CONCACAF, and Canada will rely heavily on him to contain Group B opponents at a home World Cup.
strengths: Elite shot-stopping with best-in-MLS save percentage
Outstanding at stopping shots from outside the 18-yard box (94.6% in 2025)
Commanding presence and leadership as Canada's first-choice GK
weaknesses: MLS competition level may not have tested him against elite European forwards
Distribution under pressure can be inconsistent at the highest level

maxime-crepeau.name: Maxime Crépeau
maxime-crepeau.profile: A veteran Canadian international goalkeeper who split time at Portland Timbers in 2024 before joining Orlando City ahead of 2026. Crépeau brings experience and composure from his MLS Cup-winning days at LAFC, and serves as a dependable backup and mentor to the younger St. Clair in Canada's World Cup setup.
strengths: Proven MLS pedigree and big-game experience
Strong command of his penalty area
weaknesses: Limited regular starter minutes in 2024-25 after losing starting role at Portland
Age (33) means he is closer to the end of his top-level career

owen-goodman.name: Owen Goodman
owen-goodman.profile: A rising young goalkeeper owned by Crystal Palace who spent 2024-25 on loan at AFC Wimbledon in League Two, where he was outstanding — winning the Golden Glove award, keeping 25 clean sheets in 54 appearances, and helping Wimbledon win promotion via the play-offs. His exceptional debut season at senior level flags him as Canada's long-term number one.
strengths: Exceptional clean sheet record (25 in one season) shows elite shot-stopping
Won League Two Golden Glove — best goalkeeper in the division
weaknesses: Yet to be tested above League Two standard for a sustained period
Limited international caps mean he is still building major-tournament experience

alistair-johnston.name: Alistair Johnston
alistair-johnston.profile: Canada's first-choice right back who returned from a lengthy hamstring injury late in the 2024-25 Celtic season, still managing 4 goals and 10 assists to underline his attacking threat from deep. Johnston is a technically gifted, attacking full-back whose overlapping runs and crossing ability are integral to Jesse Marsch's system at the World Cup.
strengths: Exceptional attacking output for a full-back (10 assists in 2024-25)
Strong in one-on-one situations with elite recovery pace
Consistent starter at a Champions League club
weaknesses: Missed the majority of 2024-25 with a serious hamstring injury, raising fitness questions
Defensive discipline can be exploited when caught high up the pitch

derek-cornelius.name: Derek Cornelius
derek-cornelius.profile: A centre-back who established himself in Ligue 1 with Marseille in 2024-25 with 21 league appearances in his debut season at the club. Playing under Roberto De Zerbi's high-pressing system, Cornelius developed his ability to defend in space, and brings that top-European-league experience to Canada's defence at the World Cup.
strengths: Proven at top-five European league level with Marseille
Positional intelligence and reading of the game
Won nearly 57% of duels contested — strong physical defender
weaknesses: Only 21 league appearances — still establishing himself as a consistent starter
Average ranking in interceptions among Ligue 1 centre-backs

richie-laryea.name: Richie Laryea
richie-laryea.profile: A dynamic right back or wide midfielder who returned to Toronto FC for the 2025 MLS season after time in Europe. Laryea's pace and directness make him one of Canada's most potent weapons down the right flank, and despite a slow 2025 season start due to injury, he will compete for a starting role at the World Cup as a versatile attacking option.
strengths: Outstanding pace and ability to beat defenders in wide areas
Comfortable in both right-back and wing-back roles
Strong ball carrier who creates chances from deep
weaknesses: Injury-prone — missed significant portions of the 2025 MLS season
Defensive positioning when playing as a winger can leave the right channel exposed

niko-sigur.name: Niko Sigur
niko-sigur.profile: A versatile 22-year-old defender who plays right back or defensive midfield for Hajduk Split in the Croatian HNL. Sigur made 28 appearances in 2024-25, showing the technical quality and tactical adaptability that earned him a Canada World Cup squad place, where he provides cover across the right side of defence and into midfield.
strengths: Versatility — can play right-back and defensive midfield
Technically comfortable on the ball for a defensive player
Young and improving rapidly in a competitive European league
weaknesses: Limited top-level European experience relative to the competition at a World Cup
Still developing his defensive consistency against elite opposition

joel-waterman.name: Joel Waterman
joel-waterman.profile: A dependable centre-back who joined Chicago Fire from CF Montréal during the 2025 MLS season, immediately bringing stability to the backline. Waterman's aerial prowess and willingness to put his body on the line make him a reliable option at the back for Canada, primarily as depth cover at the World Cup.
strengths: Strong in the air and dominant in physical duels
High clearance and interception output per game
Leadership and experience with Canada's national team program
weaknesses: Positional play against technical forwards can be tested
MLS level may not fully prepare him for elite World Cup strikers

luc-de-fougerolles.name: Luc de Fougerolles
luc-de-fougerolles.profile: A 20-year-old Canadian-British defender owned by Fulham who missed most of 2024-25 with a knee injury. He returned to fitness in April 2025 and secured a loan to Belgian side Dender for 2025-26, impressing with 25 appearances. His inclusion in Canada's World Cup squad reflects enormous long-term potential rather than current established status.
strengths: Strong technical ability on the ball for a young defender
Physically impressive for his age with composure in possession
Premier League contract reflects significant upside
weaknesses: Injury history — missed majority of 2024-25 with a serious knee injury
Very limited senior professional minutes before the World Cup

moise-bombito.name: Moïse Bombito
moise-bombito.profile: A commanding centre-back who made the leap from MLS to Ligue 1 by joining OGC Nice in August 2024. Bombito played 35 games across all competitions in his debut French season, establishing himself quickly as a reliable option in Nice's backline. His physical dominance and comfort on the ball suit Canada's possession-based approach.
strengths: Rapid adaptation to Ligue 1 — immediate starter in a top-half French side
Physical dominance in aerial and ground duels
Comfortable carrying the ball from defence to initiate attacks
weaknesses: First top-five European league season, so still learning the higher technical demands
Can be caught in transition when pushing high in an expansive system

alphonso-davies.name: Alphonso Davies
alphonso-davies.profile: Canada's most celebrated player and one of the best left-backs in world football. Davies had his 2024-25 Bundesliga season cut short at 19 appearances by an ACL injury sustained in March 2025, but returned to fitness in time for the World Cup. His electric pace, dribbling ability, and attacking threat from left-back make him the centrepiece of Canada's system at their home tournament.
strengths: World-class pace — among the fastest players on the planet
Elite dribbling ability and pressing from left-back
Champions League winner with experience at the very highest level
weaknesses: ACL injury (March 2025) raises questions about full fitness and explosiveness at the World Cup
Defensive positioning when advanced is sometimes exposed by quick counter-attacks

alfie-jones.name: Alfie Jones
alfie-jones.profile: An English-Canadian centre-back who was a consistent Championship performer for Middlesbrough in 2024-25, making 22 appearances and contributing 1 goal and 1 assist. Jones brings Championship-level physical defending and set-piece threat to Canada's squad as depth cover in central defence at the World Cup.
strengths: Reliable Championship-level defensive performer with 22 appearances
90.4% pass completion rate — technically sound for a centre-back
4.15 clearances per 90 — reads the game and positions well
weaknesses: Has not played above the Championship, which may be a step below World Cup standard
Accumulated 4 yellow cards and 1 red card in 22 games — disciplinary risk

stephen-eustaquio.name: Stephen Eustáquio
stephen-eustaquio.profile: Canada's engine in central midfield, Eustáquio has been a key figure at Porto in the Primeira Liga and brings elite technical quality and positional intelligence to the national team. A ball-winner who can also progress play, he is one of Canada's most influential and complete midfielders heading into the World Cup.
strengths: Elite passing range and technical ability for a defensive midfielder
Strong in the press and in winning the ball back quickly
Experienced in Champions League football with Porto
weaknesses: Physical robustness can be tested in intensive back-to-back matches
Can go missing in games where his side struggles to control possession

ismael-kone.name: Ismaël Koné
ismael-kone.profile: A dynamic box-to-box midfielder who had a difficult start at Marseille in 2024-25 before thriving on loan at Rennes in the second half of the season, scoring 2 goals in 13 Ligue 1 appearances. Now a permanent signing at Sassuolo (Serie A), Koné is a powerful midfielder who brings energy and late runs into the box for Canada.
strengths: Dynamic box-to-box runner with goalscoring ability from midfield
Strong physically and energetic pressing in transition
Rising form at Sassuolo heading into the World Cup
weaknesses: Failed to establish himself at Marseille — can struggle when tactical fit is poor
Defensive positioning and compactness remain areas to improve

tajon-buchanan.name: Tajon Buchanan
tajon-buchanan.profile: A wide midfielder who overcame a broken leg suffered during the 2024 Copa América to return and score 7 goals and assist 1 after joining Villarreal on loan from Inter Milan in February 2025, establishing himself permanently at the club. His pace and directness on the left flank give Canada a potent attacking threat.
strengths: 7 La Liga goals after joining Villarreal mid-season — instant impact
Elite pace and one-versus-one ability on the left wing
Proven at Serie A level (Inter Milan) and now La Liga
weaknesses: Missed the beginning of 2024-25 with a broken leg — conditioning questions
Defensive contribution in wide areas can be limited

mathieu-choiniere.name: Mathieu Choinière
mathieu-choiniere.profile: A technically gifted Canadian midfielder who spent 2024-25 at Grasshopper Club Zürich in the Swiss Super League (18 appearances, 1 goal) before joining LAFC on loan in August 2025, making the move permanent in December. Choinière is a creative, direct wide midfielder whose ability to unlock defences in tight spaces is valued in Jesse Marsch's Canada system.
strengths: Comfortable in multiple positions across midfield and attack
Improving at European level, progressing through Swiss to MLS with better quality clubs
weaknesses: Has not yet fully established himself as a regular starter at a top-level club
Goals and assists output remains modest relative to his attacking role

ali-ahmed.name: Ali Ahmed
ali-ahmed.profile: A dynamic attacking midfielder or wing-back who was one of Vancouver Whitecaps' standout performers in 2024 MLS before joining Norwich City in January 2026, immediately making an impact in the Championship with 4 goals in his first 12 appearances. Ahmed's dribbling ability and directness give Canada creativity from wide areas.
strengths: Elite dribbling and skill moves — one of the most direct dribblers in Canada's squad
Instant impact at Norwich (4 goals in 12 Championship games)
Versatile — effective as winger, attacking mid, and wing-back
weaknesses: Very limited time at Norwich City before the World Cup (joined January 2026)
Defensive workrate as a wide player requires improvement at international level

nathan-saliba.name: Nathan Saliba
nathan-saliba.profile: A tenacious defensive midfielder who joined Belgian giants Anderlecht from CF Montréal in July 2025 on a contract to 2029. Saliba has impressed in the Jupiler Pro League in his debut season (2025-26) with 3 goals and 31 appearances, showing the engine, aggression, and forward-driving qualities that suit Canada's high-energy system under Jesse Marsch.
strengths: High work rate and strong defensive instincts in central midfield
Ability to drive forward — ranks highly in dribbles per 90
Secured a long-term contract at a top Belgian club reflecting high regard
weaknesses: Only one season at top European club level before the World Cup
Positional discipline in midfield still being refined at the elite level

liam-millar.name: Liam Millar
liam-millar.profile: A pacy left winger who was a reliable Championship performer for Hull City in 2024-25, making 35 appearances and contributing 3 goals and 5 assists. Millar's directness on the left and ability to take on defenders provides Canada with an option down that flank.
strengths: 35 Championship appearances — consistently available and effective
Direct wide player who can beat defenders at pace
5 assists — productive as a chance creator from wide positions
weaknesses: Championship level — has not yet played at the top European leagues
Can be isolated and ineffective if his team is not in possession

jacob-shaffelburg.name: Jacob Shaffelburg
jacob-shaffelburg.profile: A versatile left-sided midfielder or winger who was a regular contributor at Nashville SC in 2024 MLS (23 appearances, 2 goals, 3 assists) before moving to Toronto FC. Shaffelburg brings intelligent movement, pressing ability, and end-product from wide areas as a depth option in Canada's World Cup squad.
strengths: Versatile — can play across the left and centre of midfield
Smart pressing and off-ball movement in Canada's high-energy system
Young enough to improve but experienced enough for a major tournament
weaknesses: Goal and assist output modest relative to his attacking role
Has moved clubs frequently, suggesting struggles to pin down a starting position

jonathan-osorio.name: Jonathan Osorio
jonathan-osorio.profile: Toronto FC's captain and Canada's senior statesman in midfield, Osorio holds the record for most career appearances in TFC history. As a combative, energetic central midfielder, he brings leadership, experience, and hard-working qualities that underpin Canada's midfield. At 33 he provides experience and mentorship at a home World Cup.
strengths: Franchise-record 326 MLS regular season appearances — elite experience and professionalism
Captain and leader who elevates team performance through example
Strong defensive midfield dueling and pressing
weaknesses: Age (33) and reduced physical output compared to peak years
MLS-level competition may limit his effectiveness against elite European midfielders

jonathan-david.name: Jonathan David
jonathan-david.profile: Canada's best and most prolific attacker, David was one of Ligue 1's top scorers for several consecutive seasons at Lille before joining Juventus in summer 2025. He scored 16 goals in Ligue 1 in 2024-25, and has established himself as a world-class striker capable of finishing in tight spaces and making intelligent runs. He is the focal point of Canada's attack at a home World Cup.
strengths: World-class finishing in and around the penalty area
Consistent top scorer across multiple seasons (16 Ligue 1 goals in 2024-25)
Excellent movement and ability to play off the shoulder of defenders
weaknesses: Can be isolated if service from midfield is limited
Not the most physically imposing striker — struggles against very large, physical centre-backs

cyle-larin.name: Cyle Larin
cyle-larin.profile: Canada's record international goalscorer and a proven La Liga striker who scored 7 goals in 32 appearances for Mallorca in 2024-25. Larin joined Southampton on loan in February 2026. A powerful, clinical centre-forward, Larin brings experience, physical presence, and a proven knack for scoring in major tournaments for Canada.
strengths: Canada's all-time leading international goalscorer — pedigree in crucial moments
Physical presence and aerial ability as a target striker
Consistent La Liga contributor (7 goals in 32 games for Mallorca in 2024-25)
weaknesses: Age (30) and physicality mean his peak years are behind him
Movement and pace not as sharp as during his Beşiktaş prime

tani-oluwaseyi.name: Tani Oluwaseyi
tani-oluwaseyi.profile: A Canadian-Nigerian forward who transferred to Villarreal from Minnesota United in August 2025, having scored 8 goals in 2024 MLS. Quick, technically sharp, and capable of playing across the front line, Oluwaseyi is one of the emerging names in Canada's attack.
strengths: Pace and directness as a wide forward — effective against high defensive lines
Proven MLS scorer who made the leap to La Liga relatively quickly
Versatile — can play across all three forward positions
weaknesses: Limited La Liga experience while adapting to European football
Still developing the consistency of a regular starter at top European club level

promise-david.name: Promise David
promise-david.profile: The biggest breakout story in Canadian football in 2024-25, Promise David scored 19 goals to help Union Saint-Gilloise win the Belgian Pro League title for the first time in 90 years. An aerially dominant, physically powerful and sharp-finishing centre-forward, David committed to Canada over Nigeria and his World Cup debut marks one of the tournament's most compelling storylines.
strengths: 19 Belgian Pro League goals — one of Europe's most in-form strikers in 2024-25
Wins over 60% of aerial duels — dominant in the air
Outperforms xG significantly (13.1 xG vs 19 goals) — elite clinical finishing
weaknesses: Belgian Pro League is not among Europe's top five — doubts remain about step-up to World Cup level
Very limited assist output (1 assist) — not a creator, purely a finisher

nikola-vasilj.name: Nikola Vasilj
nikola-vasilj.profile: Bosnia's undisputed first-choice goalkeeper, Vasilj had a spectacular debut Bundesliga season in 2024-25 after St. Pauli's promotion. His shot-stopping ability and composure under pressure earned him a place in Opta's Bundesliga Team of the Season. At the 2026 World Cup he will be the cornerstone of Bosnia's defensive organisation.
strengths: Strong command of his penalty area
weaknesses: Distribution under press can be erratic
Occasional hesitation on crosses

martin-zlomislic.name: Martin Zlomislić
martin-zlomislic.profile: Zlomislić was the backbone of Rijeka's historic 2024-25 HNL title-winning campaign, posting an outstanding 19 clean sheets and anchoring one of Croatia's best defensive units. A commanding presence between the posts with excellent reflexes, he provides quality competition for Bosnia's goalkeeping slot.
strengths: Strong positioning and reading of play
weaknesses: Limited top-level European exposure
Yet to be tested at international tournament level

osman-hadzikic.name: Osman Hadžikić
osman-hadzikic.profile: Hadžikić is the third-choice keeper in the Bosnian squad, serving as domestic-league cover behind Vasilj and Zlomislić. He has been a reliable performer in the Croatian top flight for Slaven Belupo, with consistent if unspectacular returns.
weaknesses: Limited minutes in 2024-25 due to rotation
Lacks significant European club competition experience

sead-kolasinac.name: Sead Kolašinac
sead-kolasinac.profile: The veteran left-back remains one of Bosnia's most experienced international defenders, having played a full season under Gian Piero Gasperini at Atalanta with 23 Serie A appearances alongside Champions League action. Kolašinac's physicality, tenacity and left-sided delivery make him invaluable to Bosnia's defensive setup.
weaknesses: Age-related decline in recovery pace
Positional discipline can lapse when attacking

amar-dedic.name: Amar Dedić
amar-dedic.profile: One of Europe's most exciting young right-backs, Dedić spent 2024-25 on loan at Olympique de Marseille in Ligue 1 before earning a permanent move to Benfica. Quick, technically assured, and capable of overlapping with purpose, he provides Bosnia with a modern attacking fullback and his move to Benfica signals his arrival as a genuine top-club asset.
weaknesses: Defensive positioning still maturing
Limited appearances at Marseille reduced game time in 2024-25

nihad-mujakic.name: Nihad Mujakić
nihad-mujakic.profile: A left-footed centre-back who spent the 2024-25 season at Partizan Belgrade before being loaned to Gaziantep in January 2026. Mujakić is a tough-tackling, no-nonsense defender who brings solidity to Bosnia's back line. He is comfortable playing out from the back and his Serbian SuperLiga experience added composure and physicality ahead of the World Cup.
weaknesses: Limited top-five league exposure
Modest aerial duel numbers relative to his size

nikola-katic.name: Nikola Katić
nikola-katic.profile: A towering centre-back best known for his time at Rangers, Katić spent 2024-25 at Plymouth Argyle in the Championship before signing for Schalke 04 in July 2025. His physicality, aerial dominance, and reading of the game make him a natural partner for Bosnia's back line. His tenacious style became something of a symbol at Plymouth.
strengths: Outstanding aerial duels and headed clearances
Physicality and bravery in the box
weaknesses: Limited involvement in build-up play
Positional lapses when drawn out of position

tarik-muharemovic.name: Tarik Muharemović
tarik-muharemovic.profile: The brightest defensive talent in the squad, Muharemović was the standout centre-back in Serie B in 2024-25, ranking in the 99th percentile for clearances and 88th for aerial duels won as Sassuolo won promotion to Serie A. Still only 22, he was attracting interest from Premier League clubs. At the World Cup he could be Bosnia's starting central defender for years to come.
strengths: Elite clearances and aerial dominance (99th percentile in Serie B)
Exceptional reading of the game for his age
weaknesses: Relatively inexperienced at Serie A and Champions League level
Can be drawn into unnecessary fouls

stjepan-radeljic.name: Stjepan Radeljić
stjepan-radeljic.profile: A key member of Rijeka's title-winning 2024-25 HNL squad, Radeljić was described as one of the champions' standout performers throughout the season. The left-footed centre-back provides reliable depth for Bosnia's defensive options and is comfortable on the ball when Rijeka chose to build from the back.
strengths: Championship-winning defensive quality at domestic level
Strong leadership qualities — named club captain at Rijeka
weaknesses: Limited exposure to top-five European leagues
Aerial duel numbers moderate compared to elite centre-backs

dennis-hadzikadunic.name: Dennis Hadžikadunić
dennis-hadzikadunic.profile: A Swedish-born Bosnian centre-back who spent 2024-25 at Hamburger SV in the 2. Bundesliga, making 25 appearances and scoring 1 goal before joining Sampdoria on loan. An aerial specialist by profile, he brings physical defending and experience across multiple European second-tier competitions. His adaptability and organisational instincts make him a useful squad option for Bosnia.
strengths: Physical and committed in defensive duels
Versatile — played at various clubs across Europe
weaknesses: Limited success rate in ground duels
Has yet to sustain a spell in a top-five league

nidal-celic.name: Nidal Čelić
nidal-celic.profile: The youngest outfield player in Bosnia's squad, Čelić broke through at FK Sarajevo in 2024-25 — where he was named captain despite his age — before completing a high-profile move to RC Lens in February 2025. At 192cm with exceptional composure, he is viewed as a future cornerstone of Bosnia's defence. His selection for the 2026 World Cup squad at just 19 underscores his enormous potential.
strengths: Exceptional potential and maturity beyond his years
Physical presence and aerial ability at 192cm
Strong passing and ability to play out from the back
weaknesses: Limited Ligue 1 appearances to date
Inexperience at the highest club level yet to be fully tested

amir-hadziahmetovic.name: Amir Hadžiahmetović
amir-hadziahmetovic.profile: A hard-working defensive midfielder who spent 2024-25 primarily on loan at Rizespor in the Süper Lig before returning to Beşiktaş and subsequently moving on loan to Hull City in the Championship. His industry, pressing ability, and reading of the game make him a valued engine room presence for Bosnia's midfield, screening the back four effectively.
strengths: High defensive output and pressing intensity
weaknesses: Limited creative contribution going forward
Has struggled with lack of settled club situation

ivan-sunjic.name: Ivan Šunjić
ivan-sunjic.profile: A physically imposing defensive midfielder who won a first-ever league title with Pafos FC in Cyprus in 2024-25, Šunjić joined the club after leaving Birmingham City and revived his career impressively. His strength, aerial ability, and no-nonsense defending in midfield have kept him in Bosnia's plans despite playing outside the top leagues.
strengths: Strong aerial ability for a midfielder
Winning mentality — contributed to Pafos title
weaknesses: Disciplinary record limits reliability
Playing standard in Cyprus below top European leagues

ivan-basic.name: Ivan Bašić
ivan-basic.profile: A technically gifted left-footed midfielder who spent 2024-25 at FK Orenburg in the Russian Premier League before joining FC Astana in Kazakhstan, Bašić became the only Kazakhstan Premier League player at the 2026 World Cup after helping Bosnia qualify through the play-offs. His passing accuracy, clever movement, and ability to carry the ball make him a dynamic option from midfield.
weaknesses: Competition standard in Kazakhstan below top European leagues
Physicality in midfield battles still developing

dzenis-burnic.name: Dženis Burnić
